item.title: Cabinet clears Demo Rural Credit Scheme, outlay Rs 5000 crore
item.description: The Cabinet cleared the Demo Rural Credit Scheme on Monday. The scheme, with an outlay of Rs 5000 crore, will be implemented by NABARD over five years. Small farmers will get collateral-free loans.
